posts.title: ETH sucks

content:

posts.title: Accessing the internet , anonymous
posts.excerpt: There are varying threat models and purchasing power here is a guide to sweet spot for each accessible enough to the everyday man
content:
Level 1:Everyday piracy and censorship evasion
A VPN is enough , free if you are a brokie but i recommend atleast anything paid , mullvad is famous you can try that they accept crypto for payments so there is no indirect banking linked KYC or if using banking choose a hostile jurisdiction like hong kong for west.
Level 2:Junkie or drug dealer
Tor on Tails is all you really need maybe use obfs4 for extra good measure but really thats it your opsec will betray you before tor.
Level 3:Naughty niggas
TOR to VPS is the gold standard .Some things to keep in mind Host the guard node yourself,skip EU relays especially german,Choose a hostile jurisdiction for VPS(Very important to avoid ISP packet analysis).
Level 4:Great firewall
Try the above three levels first .Then attempt residential proxy relays they are expensive but if nothing else works they are your last hope should work for months before the AI flags you and its grey enough to not warrant prosecution by itself
